bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a grant to Hnub Tshiab: Hmong Women Achieving Together.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HNUB TSHIAB: HMONG WOMEN ACHIEVING TOGETHER. +]

[+$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Hnub Tshiab: Hmong Women Achieving Together, to acquire property for and to predesign, design, construct, renovate, furnish, and equip a community center in Ramsey County, for educational and leadership development programs to promote and strengthen cultural knowledge and identity, and social change to improve the lives of Hmong women and girls. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a grant to Hnub Tshiab: Hmong Women Achieving Together.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HNUB TSHIAB: HMONG WOMEN ACHIEVING TOGETHER.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Hnub Tshiab: Hmong Women Achieving Together, to acquire property for and to predesign, design, construct, renovate, furnish, and equip a community center in Ramsey County, for educational and leadership development programs to promote and strengthen cultural knowledge and identity, and social change to improve the lives of Hmong women and girls. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.
